Exceptional service and a convenient location 2.2 km from Vietnam Central Circus make the affordable hostel a great place to stay. Found around a 25-minute walk from the Union Park, this Hanoi hostel is in proximity to worship locations like the Temple of the Jade Mountain. The 122-room Old Quarter View Hanoi hostel is also only 0.8 km from the Lake of the Restored Sword. The property is situated just moments from the bustling Hanoi Night Market. New Day Restaurant restaurant is just near the Hanoi accommodation. This hostel is merely 5 minutes' walk from Good Morning Cat Ba bus station. Bicycle hire is available at the Hanoi hostel.
